clips.title: The story
paras: At Westfall Lighthouse, Captain Grayson keeps watch over the coast. The spectral sailor seeks oil to keep the beacon burning after murlocs killed the living keepers, so ships can pass the reefs safely.

Westfall Lighthouse stands on a rocky islet off the zone’s southwest shore, where its light once guided sailors through the Great Sea’s shallow waters. That duty ended when Old Murk-Eye led a murloc attack and killed the keeper and his family. Captain Grayson, a sailor who died in the waters by these rocks, now watches over the tower as a ghost. Death left him unable to stop the slaughter, but he will not let the lighthouse go dark.

No living keeper remains to tend the flame, so Captain Grayson needs an unusual fuel. The rogue Harvest Watchers roaming Westfall’s abandoned farmlands carry flasks of machinery oil inside their rusted bodies. Grayson sends you ashore to recover the oil from these broken constructs. With it, the beacon can keep burning and guide other captains past the reefs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The night the Lighthouse Keeper's family died was horrible. I watched, helpless, as Old Murk-Eye led the attack. But what's done is done and now my concern is for the lives of the sailors on The Great Sea whose ships come close to the perilous rocks of the coastline. With no one to keep watch on the flame the responsibility has fallen upon me.
Help me keep the torch lit by bringing me 5 flasks of oil from the Harvest Monsters.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The flame will not burn for long without oil, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Praise you, brave adventurer. The rocks of the Westfall Coast shall be lit thanks to your hard work. Many lives will be spared so long as the torch is kept lit.
I died needlessly on this very shore. My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny.
